pairs.target: dìèrtiān wǔhòu , yīwén bǎ yíyè zhàng tān zài chángwū de chuāng xià , méiyòng bēizi yā zhǐ , dào jiāng zìjǐ nà jiàn jiù wàiyī zhé chéng yìtiáo , diàn zài juǎn biānshàng .
pairs.english: The next afternoon Iven spread one ledger page under the longhouse window; instead of using a cup to weigh the paper down, he folded his own old coat into a strip and tucked it beneath the curled edge.
pairs.hanzi: 第二天午后，伊文把一页账摊在长屋的窗下，没用杯子压纸，倒将自己那件旧外衣折成一条，垫在卷边上。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gāng cóng zǎokè huílái , kànjiàn tā lùchū de bànjié lǐngkǒu , wèn nà chù hái méi bǔ me , yīwén shuō xiān bié kàn zìjǐ de yīfu , jīnrì yào jiè tā yìzhī yǎnjīng .
pairs.english: Tavi had just returned from morning class; seeing his half exposed collar, he asked whether that spot was still unmended; Iven said first stop looking at his clothes, today he wanted to borrow one of Tavi's eyes.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维刚从早课回来，看见他露出的半截领口，问那处还没补么，伊文说先别看自己的衣服，今日要借他一只眼睛。

pairs.target: tā qù jiàn zhàngfáng shì sān rìqián de shì , huílái hòu yǐ jiāng liǎngchù tiān gǎi chóngchāo guò , jīnrì cái nádào jiùfù zhǔn tā dàihuí de nà zhāng fù yè .
pairs.english: He had met the accountant three days earlier; after returning he had recopied the two amendments, and only today obtained the duplicate page his uncle had allowed him to take back.
pairs.hanzi: 他去见账房是三日前的事，回来后已将两处添改重抄过，今日才拿到舅父准他带回的那张副页。

pairs.target: qīng wěi nàtiáo chuán de zhàng yǐjīng gǎi qīng , zhèhuí wèn de shì lìng yíyè lǐ liǎngbǐ hòu bó qián , jì zài chuán xià , què yòu zhào huò fēn dào jǐjiā tóushàng .
pairs.english: The Green Tail boat's account had already been corrected; this enquiry concerned two berth-waiting charges on another page, entered under the boat but also divided among firms by cargo, several of them.
pairs.hanzi: 青尾那条船的账已经改清，这回问的是另一页里两笔候泊钱，记在船下，却又照货分到几家头上。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànzhe tóngyígè shù chūxiàn liǎnghuí , xiān wèn shìbushì yòu shōu le yíbiàn , yīwén méiyǒu diǎntóu , qǔchū xiǎo zhǐtiáo , jiào tā xiān kàn mòwěi nà xíng dǐkòu .
pairs.english: Seeing the same number appear twice, Tavi first asked if it had been collected again; Iven did not nod, taking out a small slip and telling him to look first at that last deduction line.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看着同一个数出现两回，先问是不是又收了一遍，伊文没有点头，取出小纸条，叫他先看末尾那行抵扣。

pairs.target: dǐkòu xiě de hěnzhǎi , tǎ wéi bǎ zhǐ zhuǎn dào liàng chù , cái rènchū hòutou shǎodiào de yìbǐ zhènghǎo bǔ huí qiántou , zìjǐ fāngcái yǐ bǎ shǒuzhǐ àn zài le cuòchù .
pairs.english: The deduction was squeezed into a narrow space; Tavi turned the paper toward the light, only then recognising that the amount removed later exactly offset the earlier one; just before, his finger had already been on the wrong spot.
pairs.hanzi: 抵扣写得很窄，塔维把纸转到亮处，才认出后头少掉的一笔正好补回前头，自己方才已把手指按在了错处。

pairs.target: yīwén méiyǒu xiào tā , nábǐ jiāng liǎngchù quān lián qǐlái , shuō zìjǐ zài zhàngfáng nàlǐ yě wèn guò tóng yíjù , duìfāng fān dào zhèlǐ shí , zìjǐ hái xiǎng tóng rén zhēng .
pairs.english: Iven did not laugh at him; using a pen, he circled both places and connected them, saying that he too had asked the accountant there the same question, and still wanted to argue with the man when the page was turned to this part.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文没有笑他，拿笔将两处圈连起来，说自己在账房那里也问过同一句，对方翻到这里时，自己还想同人争。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi táitóu wèn , nà háiyǒu shénme méiwán , yīwén bǎ zhǐ yíkāi yìdiǎn , zhǐxiàng lìng yìháng , shuō qián méiyǒu chóng shōu , hòu bó de liǎngrì què hái méi wènqīng .
pairs.english: Tavi looked up and asked what remained unresolved then; Iven moved the paper a little aside, pointing to another line: the money had not been collected twice, but those two days of waiting were still unexplained.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维抬头问，那还有什么没完，伊文把纸移开一点，指向另一行，说钱没有重收，候泊的两日却还没问清。

pairs.target: nàtiáo chuán zhuāng guò huò , líndào yí bó yòu bèi liúzài wài wān , zhàngfáng náchū de shì chāo lái de shíchén , méiyǒu dāngbān de rén míng , yě méi xiě wèishénme ràng lìng yìpī xiān zǒu .
pairs.english: That boat had loaded cargo, but when about to move berths was kept in the outer bay again; the accountant produced copied times, without names of those on duty or any explanation why another group was let through first.
pairs.hanzi: 那条船装过货，临到移泊又被留在外湾，账房拿出的是抄来的时辰，没有当班的人名，也没写为什么让另一批先走。

pairs.target: " xiān zǒu de shǎojiāo zhè liǎngrì ? "
pairs.english: “The ones let through first pay less for those two days?”
pairs.hanzi: “先走的少交这两日？”

pairs.target: yīwén shuō nà jǐtiáo bú zài zhè yíyè shàng , zìjǐ hái méi kànguò , huà shuō de kuài le xiē , yòu jiāng bǐ fàngxià , bùkěn tì kòng zhe de dìfāng xiān tián yígè rén .
pairs.english: Iven said those boats were not on this page and he had not looked yet; his words came a little faster, then he put down the pen, refusing to fill an empty place with a person in advance.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文说那几条不在这一页上，自己还没看过，话说得快了些，又将笔放下，不肯替空着的地方先填一个人。

pairs.target: zhàngfáng shuō wài wān duō liú yíyè , kān lǎn de rén yě děi lǐngqián , bìng búshì zhǐ shàng mǒdiào liǎng zì , nà yíyè biàn méiyǒu rén gànhuó , yīwén tīng zhe gèng nǎo , juéde duìfāng xiān dāng zìjǐ yào làizhàng .
pairs.english: The accountant said staying an extra night in the outer bay meant the rope-watchers must be paid too; erasing two words on paper did not mean nobody worked that night; hearing this, Iven grew more annoyed, feeling the man had already taken him for someone dodging payment.
pairs.hanzi: 账房说外湾多留一夜，看缆的人也得领钱，并不是纸上抹掉两字，那一夜便没有人干活，伊文听着更恼，觉得对方先当自己要赖账。

pairs.target: tā shuō dào zhèlǐ , shǒuzhǐ réng niē zhe zhǐ jiǎo , tǎ wéi wèn hòulái ne , tā cái shuō hòulái bǎ nà jù yàn huíqù le , xiān qǐng duìfāng zhǐmíng , nǎ yìbǐ shì gěi kān lǎn de rén .
pairs.english: As he spoke of this, his fingers still pinched the paper corner; Tavi asked what happened later, and only then he said that afterwards he had swallowed those words, first asking the man to point out which charge paid the rope-watchers.
pairs.hanzi: 他说到这里，手指仍捏着纸角，塔维问后来呢，他才说后来把那句咽回去了，先请对方指明，哪一笔是给看缆的人。

pairs.target: nà yìbǐ fēn de chūlái , lìngwài yìbǐ wèishénme yě àn tóngyàng de rìzi qǐ suàn , zhàngfáng què jiào tā lìng wèn , méi kěn bǎ zìjǐ bù jīngshǒu de yě yíbìng dá le .
pairs.english: That charge could be distinguished; why the other one began counting from the same date too, however, the accountant told him to ask elsewhere, unwilling to answer all the matters outside his own remit as well.
pairs.hanzi: 那一笔分得出来，另外一笔为什么也按同样的日子起算，账房却叫他另问，没肯把自己不经手的也一并答了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngqǐ huò háng nà liàng hái liúzài nánpō de chē , wèn shìbushì yě néng xiān kòuzhù búsuàn , yīwén shuō zìjǐ de zhàngfáng guǎn búdào nà yìháng , yě bù zhīdào tāmen qiān de shì shénme .
pairs.english: Tavi remembered that cart of the freight firm still at South Slope, asking whether payment could be withheld there too; Iven said his accountant did not handle that business, nor did he know what they had signed.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想起货行那辆还留在南坡的车，问是不是也能先扣住不算，伊文说自己的账房管不到那一行，也不知道他们签的是什么。

pairs.target: chuāngwài yǒurén dǒu bèi , xì huī luòdào chuāngtái , yīwén jiāng zhàng táiqǐ lái , tǎ wéi tì tā fúdiào yī shàng nà diǎn huī , shǒuzhǐ xiǎnxiē pèngdào yìgēn méi chōu jìng de jiù xiàn .
pairs.english: Someone shook bedding outside the window, fine dust falling on the sill; Iven lifted the ledger, and Tavi brushed that dust from his coat for him, his fingers almost touching an old thread not fully pulled out.
pairs.hanzi: 窗外有人抖被，细灰落到窗台，伊文将账抬起来，塔维替他拂掉衣上那点灰，手指险些碰到一根没抽净的旧线。

pairs.target: lǐngkǒu xiàmiàn nà dào sī kǒu hái zài , yīwén bǎ yīfu qiǎng huí , shuō zhè xià kàn gòu le méiyǒu , tǎ wéi shuō ruò bù nálái yā zhǐ , zìjǐ yuánxiān méi dǎsuàn chá de zhèyàng xì .
pairs.english: The tear under the collar remained; Iven snatched the coat back, asking had he looked enough now; Tavi said if it had not been used as a paperweight, he had not planned such a close inspection in the first place.
pairs.hanzi: 领口下面那道撕口还在，伊文把衣服抢回，说这下看够了没有，塔维说若不拿来压纸，自己原先没打算查得这样细。

pairs.target: liǎng rén xiào guò , yīwén què jiāng nà xíng shíchén dì dào tā yǎnqián , wèn ruò zìjǐ qù wèn dāngbān de rén , zhǐ shuō qián bú duì , huì buhuì yì kāikǒu biàn wèn cuò .
pairs.english: After both laughed, Iven held that line of times before him, asking if he went to the duty staff himself and only said the money was wrong, would the question be mistaken from the outset.
pairs.hanzi: 两人笑过，伊文却将那行时辰递到他眼前，问若自己去问当班的人，只说钱不对，会不会一开口便问错。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō zìjǐ rènbùchū bóchuán de shíchén , yīwén shuō búshì jiào tā dài suàn , shì wèn tā fāngcái dàodǐ méi kànjiàn nǎlǐ , zhè yíjù dào jiào tā ānjìngxiàlái .
pairs.english: Tavi said he could not read the berthing times; Iven said he was not asking him to calculate, but asking what exactly he had missed before, and that made him quiet.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说自己认不出泊船的时辰，伊文说不是叫他代算，是问他方才到底没看见哪里，这一句倒叫他安静下来。

pairs.target: tā chóngxīn kàn zhǐ , zhǐ zhù nà xíng dǐkòu , shuō zìjǐ xiān kànjiàn yíyàng de shù , jiù méi wǎnghòu zhǎo , ruò yǒurén zhǐ gěi zìjǐ kàn qiántou , duōbàn biàn xìn le .
pairs.english: He looked at the paper again, pointing to that deduction line; he said seeing the same number first, he had not looked further, and if someone showed him only the beginning, he would probably believe it.
pairs.hanzi: 他重新看纸，指住那行抵扣，说自己先看见一样的数，就没往后找，若有人只给自己看前头，多半便信了。

pairs.target: yīwén bǎ zhè jù lìngjì dào xiǎo zhǐtiáo shàng , méiyǒu tiān shàng tǎ wéi de míngzì , yě méi shuō yào ná tā tóng shuí zhēng , zhǐ jiāng fù yè hé zìjǐ de wènhuà fēn kāifàng .
pairs.english: Iven noted this separately on the small slip, without adding Tavi's name or saying whom he would argue with using it; he only stored the duplicate and his own questions separately.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文把这句另记到小纸条上，没有添上塔维的名字，也没说要拿它同谁争，只将副页和自己的问话分开放。

pairs.target: guò le yíhuìer , tā shuō zhàngfáng yě bùkěn bǎozhèng dāngbān de rén hái jìde , qù wèn zhǐnéng zìjǐ zǒu yìhuí , jiùfù zhècì bú tì tā shāo kǒuxìn .
pairs.english: After a while he said the accountant would not guarantee the duty staff remembered either; to ask, he could only go himself once; this time his uncle would not carry a message for him.
pairs.hanzi: 过了一会儿，他说账房也不肯保证当班的人还记得，去问只能自己走一回，舅父这次不替他捎口信。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎng shuō kěyǐ péi , què xiān wèn zài nǎlǐ , yīwén shuō chénglǐ de bó huò fáng , rìzi háiyào yuē , suíhòu piēyìyǎn tā de zuǒtuǐ , shuō yě búshì jiào tā qù zhuī chuán .
pairs.english: Tavi wanted to offer company but first asked where; Iven said the city's berth office, with the date still to arrange, then glanced at his left leg, saying he was not asking him to chase boats either.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想说可以陪，却先问在哪里，伊文说城里的泊货房，日子还要约，随后瞥一眼他的左腿，说也不是叫他去追船。

pairs.target: " wǒ hái méi shuō qù . "
pairs.english: “I haven't said I'd go yet.”
pairs.hanzi: “我还没说去。”

pairs.target: " nǐ fāngcái nà zhāng liǎn yǐjīng dào mǎtóu le . "
pairs.english: “That face of yours had already reached the docks just now, indeed.”
pairs.hanzi: “你方才那张脸已经到码头了。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ yīfu dìhuí , zhèhuí yīwén méiyǒu zài diàn chuāng biān , jiāng tā pī dào jiānshàng , lǐngkǒu nà dào jiù xiàn biàn lù le chūlái .
pairs.english: Tavi handed back the coat; this time Iven did not prop the window edge again, but draped it over his shoulders, and that old collar thread was exposed.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把衣服递回，这回伊文没有再垫窗边，将它披到肩上，领口那道旧线便露了出来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kàn le yízhèn , wèn yào buyào zìjǐ ná zhēn lái , yīwén shuō zhēn zài xiá lǐ , xiān biétì tā féngsǐ , chuānyī shí nà chù hái děi néng fānguòqù .
pairs.english: Tavi looked a while, asking should he fetch the needle; Iven said the needle was in the case, but first do not sew it shut for him: that spot must still fold over when dressing.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看了一阵，问要不要自己拿针来，伊文说针在匣里，先别替他缝死，穿衣时那处还得能翻过去。

pairs.target: zhēn nálái yǐhòu , zhǐ yǐjīng shōu hǎo , yīwén zìjǐ bǎ sī kǒu duìqí , tǎ wéi tì tā chuān le xiàn , dìyīhuí méi chuān jìnqù , liǎnggè rén de tóu què yǐ còu de hěn jìn .
pairs.english: By the time the needle arrived, the paper had been put away; Iven aligned the tear himself, while Tavi threaded it for him; the first try failed, though their two heads were already very close.
pairs.hanzi: 针拿来以后，纸已经收好，伊文自己把撕口对齐，塔维替他穿了线，第一回没穿进去，两个人的头却已凑得很近。

pairs.target: yīwén xián tā còu de dǎngguāng , jiào tā wǎng zuǒ nuó , tǎ wéi zuò zhe nuó le dèngzi , xiàntóu zhè cái cóng zhēn yǎnlǐ lùchū lái , xì de xiàng fāngcái zěnme yě rènbùqīng de nà yìháng .
pairs.english: Iven complained he was blocking the light and told him to move left; Tavi shifted his stool while seated, and only then did the thread emerge through the needle's eye, as fine as that line which he could not read at all before.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文嫌他凑得挡光，叫他往左挪，塔维坐着挪了凳子，线头这才从针眼里露出来，细得像方才怎么也认不清的那一行。

pairs.target: zhēnjiǎo zǒuguò liǎngcùn , yīwén tíngxiàlái , bǎ lǐngkǒu fānguò yícì , jiàn méiyǒu féng dào lǐ céng , cái jìxù wǎngqián , tǎ wéi yǐjīng bǎ diàn zài xī shàng de kōng xiàn zhǐ zhé chéng le xiǎochuán .
pairs.english: After two inches of stitching, Iven stopped and turned the collar once; seeing the lining had not been sewn through, he continued; Tavi had already folded the empty thread paper on his knee into a little boat.
pairs.hanzi: 针脚走过两寸，伊文停下来，把领口翻过一次，见没有缝到里层，才继续往前，塔维已经把垫在膝上的空线纸折成了小船。

pairs.target: yīwén kànjiàn , shuō zhè tiáo bùxǔ rùzhàng , shēnshǒu jiāng zhǐchuán bō dào chuāng xià , chuántóu pèng zhe mù yán , tíng zài yìxiǎopiàn wǔhòu de guāng lǐ .
pairs.english: Iven saw it, said this one must not enter the ledger, and reached to nudge the paper boat under the window; its bow touched the wooden edge and stopped in a small patch of afternoon light.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文看见，说这条不许入账，伸手将纸船拨到窗下，船头碰着木沿，停在一小片午后的光里。
